description: This file defines the PluginExistsConstraint class used for validating the existence and interface implementation of plugins within Drupal, including dependency injection and validation logic.

classes.name: PluginExistsConstraint
classes.description: A validation constraint class that checks for the existence of a plugin and optionally its interface implementation within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor for PluginExistsConstraint, initializing plugin manager, interface, fallback options, and error messages.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of PluginExistsConstraint from a container and configuration, handling deprecated options.

methods.name: getDefaultOption
methods.description: Returns the default option key for the constraint, which is 'manager'.

methods.name: getRequiredOptions
methods.description: Returns an array of required options, specifically ['manager'].
